BETA Close X Serco Group plc has executed further share repurchases as part of its ongoing buyback program, acquiring a total of 1,713,211 ordinary shares between September 7th and September 11th, 2026, at an average price of approximately 250.47 pence per share. These purchases bring the total number of shares bought back since the program's inception on August 11th, 2026, to 6,907,540, which are now held in treasury. Following these transactions, Serco Group plc has 967,388,009 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 11 September 2026 11 September 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 11 August 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 35,358,005 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 11 September 2026 is 967,388,009 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
